name: Groceries List
description: Look up groceries at Jumbo, AH, Lidl and the rest side by side. Lists that sort themselves by shop and aisle. Nova only.
details:
Search products across Jumbo, Albert Heijn, Hoogvliet, Lidl and Picnic from one search bar — filter results down to a single store or sort by price, high to low or low to high. Each result shows a picture, name, price, and which market it's from.

Add anything you find to a shopping list with one tap. As you add items, the list automatically groups itself by supermarket and then by aisle/category, showing a running subtotal per store and a grand total for the whole list. Keep as many separate lists as you want — a weekly shop, a dinner party, whatever.

Groceries List is included free with the Nova plan.
